complexity.notes: Both rob1's padded copy and the two slices make this O(n) space; O(1) is easy by tracking two rolling totals (prev, curr) instead of writing into a list. The len(nums) > 1 guard is needed since nums[1:] would be empty for a single house.
complexity.summary: Reduces the circular problem to two linear House Robber runs — one over nums[:-1], one over nums[1:] — and takes the max, using the standard in-place DP where each house is either robbed (adding to i-2) or skipped (taking i-1).
